<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="328" y1="19" x2="328" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="333" y1="19" x2="333" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="19" x2="338" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="352" y1="16" x2="356" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="9" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="11" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="93" x2="390" y2="93" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="35,61 27,68 35,75" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="68" x2="49" y2="68" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">tinder</text>
  <g>
    <text x="365" y="68" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FE3675">DONE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- heading and progress -->
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">What is your ethnicity?</text>
  <text x="24" y="157" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that best describes you.</text>
  <rect x="24" y="174" width="342" height="5" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <rect x="24" y="174" width="228" height="5" rx="3" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  <text x="366" y="169" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">4 OF 6</text>

  <!-- list card shadow -->
  <rect x="22" y="198" width="346" height="453" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
  <rect x="22" y="196" width="346" height="453" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- option 1 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="232" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Asian</text>
    <text x="44" y="250" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">East, South, or Southeast Asian</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="231" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="231" r="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="269" x2="348" y2="269" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- option 2 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="305" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Black / African Descent</text>
    <text x="44" y="323" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">African, Caribbean, or Black heritage</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="304" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="342" x2="348" y2="342" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- option 3 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="378" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Hispanic / Latino</text>
    <text x="44" y="396" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Spanish, Latin American, or Latino heritage</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="377" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="415" x2="348" y2="415" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- option 4 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="451" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Middle Eastern</text>
    <text x="44" y="469" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Middle Eastern or North African heritage</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="450" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="488" x2="348" y2="488" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- option 5 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="524" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">White</text>
    <text x="44" y="542" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">European or Caucasian heritage</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="523" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="561" x2="348" y2="561" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- option 6 -->
  <g>
    <text x="44" y="597" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Other</text>
    <text x="44" y="615" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">An ethnicity not listed above</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="596" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- helper note -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="682" r="8" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="28" y="686" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
  <text x="44" y="679" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#7D8490">Your ethnicity is shown on your profile.</text>
  <text x="44" y="697" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#7D8490">You can change this anytime in Settings.</text>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="91" y="718" width="208" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="745" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="785" width="390" height="59" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="785" x2="390" y2="785" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,807 48,798 58,807 58,818 51,818 51,810 45,810 45,818 38,818" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="48" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="126" cy="806" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="803" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <ellipse cx="126" cy="812" rx="6" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="126" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="806" r="13" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <polygon points="195,798 197,804 204,804 198,808 200,814 195,810 190,814 192,808 186,804 193,804" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FE3675">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="266" y="799" width="17" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="270,812 270,817 275,812" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="271" cy="805" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="275" cy="805" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="279" cy="805" r="1.2" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="274" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">CHATS</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="347" cy="804" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="801" r="2.2" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="347" cy="808" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="797" r="3" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="347" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">SETTINGS</text>
  </g>
</svg>
